description: Fixed documented prompt set for the agent-engine-port parity harness (task 7.1). Both agents (AGENT_UUID_OR / AGENT_UUID_HERMIQ) must be configured with the SAME system prompt, model, and tool whitelist for these prompts to be comparable. Prompts are deliberately generic — no register-specific vocabulary — so the set is reusable on any instance.

prompts.prompt: Reply in one short sentence: what is the capital of France?
prompts.note: Plain chat turn. Expected structural outcome: zero tool calls on both paths, user -> assistant persistence.

prompts.prompt: Use one of your available tools to look something up, then tell me in one sentence what the tool returned.
prompts.note: Should trigger at least one call on a whitelisted tool. The tool-call-sequence check compares tool ids and argument key sets in order; argument values are logged, not asserted.

prompts.prompt: Search the data available to you for the term 'test' and report how many results you found.
prompts.note: A directed tool invocation with a concrete argument, exercising argument-shape comparison.

prompts.prompt: Using only the documents and objects available to you as context, summarise in two sentences what this workspace is about.
prompts.note: RAG-flavored: exercises the source count/shape checks (send-sources, persisted-assistant-sources).
